summary: A candidate says in public they are leaving and will resign if elected, then tells an ally privately that they would stay.
realLife: A school board candidate who lost endorsements announced he was quitting, texted a board member that he would serve if chosen, and later posted a statement citing family and supporters.
sources: OPB, school board candidate withdraws again, May 10, 2023: https://www.opb.org/article/2023/05/10/portland-school-board-candidate-derrick-peterson-withdraws-from-the-race-again
